mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior 3 months compresses discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines over 3 months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month rise in unemployment rate above 5.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 5.0% in 3 months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and rise in retail sales (RSAFS) indicates a shift from consumer spending to housing, signaling economic weakness and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST declines and RSAFS rises, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and CPIAUCSL < 2.0%), hawkish policy increases real interest rates and reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and CPIAUCSL < 2.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) over the prior 3 months indicates strong labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS increases over 3 months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in industrial production below 110.0 signals manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate profits, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO falls below 110.0 in 3 months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During strong economic expansions (GDPC1 quarterly growth > 1.5% and HOUST rising), robust consumer demand boosts corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 > 1.5% quarterly growth and HOUST rising
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when GDPC1 growth exceeds 1.5% and HOUST is rising, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous rise in federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and decline in core inflation (CPIAUCSL) signals hawkish policy without inflationary pressure, increasing real rates and reducing equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS rises and CPIAUCSL declines, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
